messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx/timeouts observed on streaming gateway (us-west). Auto-pager triggered. Thread for live triage.

maya: seeing lots of chunked connection resets reported by gateway logs, looks correlated with long-lived chat sessions. rolling count: ~180 5xxs in last 5m.

sachin: confirmed, traces show partial chunks then client closes. Upstream model pods returning normal responses, gateway stream to client resets mid-body.

elaine: is this the same as the earlier partial-frames issue? any new sigs?

maya: different. earlier was trailer corruption. this is frequent short-lived ECONNRESET between edge proxy and client after first few chunks. clients report immediate UI failure.

ryan: customer-success pinged — some enterprise customers seeing failed streaming responses on long completions (>=1000 tokens). CS says it’s causing degraded UX but not data loss.

customer-success: FYI, Customer AcmeApps reported 12 failures in last 30m, majority on our hosted API, not dedicated. They asked for ETA.

incident-bot: Paging eng-runtime and eng-sre oncall. Escalation level: high. Incident ID INC-4928.

ops-bot: Oncall rota: sachin (eng-runtime), ryan (eng-sre). Handoff assigned.

maya: quick mitigation idea: heartbeat keepalives for streaming clients were disabled in latest edge rollout (a1b2c3d). Can we flip the keepalive back on?

sachin: confirming config diff now. I see keepalive opt removed in edge-proxy v2.4.1 (sha a1b2c3d). Reverting should be straightforward.

elaine: what's impact of keepalive? risk of false positives?

ryan: keepalive prevents intermediate LB/proxy from treating stream as idle and closing. If we re-enable, should drop these mid-stream resets. Low-risk config rollback; we can do a canary to 5% first.

maya: customer impact estimate: roughly 3-4% of streaming sessions, concentrated on sessions >30s.

sachin: running quick check on logs to confirm proxy closes:
```
E 2026-03-15T16:12:03.213Z gateway edge-proxy[conn=837] "chunked" err=client_reset mid-stream
W 2026-03-15T16:12:03.214Z backend runtime-pod-12: upstream ok
```

sachin: shows gateway closing after 2 chunks; backend finished fine. Points to edge/ingress timeout.

james: can we also enable connection-level heartbeats from runtime->gateway? if both sides have keepalive, safer.

ryan: yes, but config surfaces vary across cloud regions. For immediate mitigation, I'll roll a config revert to edge-proxy canary (5%) in us-west, monitor 10m, then 100%.

maya: while that is rolling, we should add fallback path: for sessions where streaming fails, convert to paged (non-streaming) response automatically to reduce customer-visible failures. Can we do that quickly?

sachin: we have code path for paged fallback in router. It's gated behind a feature flag stream_fallback=true. I can flip it for the gateway layer as emergency toggle. Will opt-only for our hosted tier to avoid surprising dedicated customers.

elaine: good call. set feature in edge-config and add response header X-Redwood-Stream-Retry: paged for observability.

incident-bot: Action items: 1) sachin - enable stream_fallback feature for hosted in us-west. 2) ryan - canary revert for keepalive on edge-proxy. 3) maya - monitor customer error rate and report impact. 4) james - prepare runtime heartbeat PR for next deploy.

sachin: enabling stream_fallback now. Command: `edge-configctl set hosted.stream_fallback true --region us-west`

sachin: done. Verifying logs for fallback header.

maya: seeing immediate reduction in customer errors for paged flows in logs (sampled). Some customers get paged fallback, CS notified.

ryan: starting canary revert: `deploy edge-proxy v2.4.2-revertkeepalive --canary=5% --region=us-west`

ops-bot: Canary deployment started.

sachin: quick note — fallback increases token-per-request cost slightly because we buffer full response, but better UX. Marking tradeoff in incident notes.

maya: customer-impact update: AcmeApps failures dropped from 12->2 in 12m after fallback. They still see a couple of failed streams.

ryan: canary metrics at +7m: 5xx rate on streaming endpoint down 78% in canary cohort. Latency stable. Proceeding to 50% ramp.

ops-bot: Canary ramp to 50% complete.

james: preparing PR for runtime heartbeats: adding `--stream-heartbeat=20s` flag to runtime agent. Will submit for review and can be fast-tracked.

elaine: we should also add a short-term change to gateway timeouts: increase idle timeout from 30s->90s for streaming routes in us-west. That will help clients with intermittent network.

ryan: applied edge-proxy route timeout tweak in canary group. Monitoring.

maya: monitoring shows remaining failures are mostly client-side cancellations (UI closing socket) rather than gateway closes. CS investigating client SDK.

customer-success: AcmeApps confirms they rolled an SDK update that might close socket early on retry. We'll coordinate.

sachin: good to know. So mitigation split: gateway config + server keepalive handles network-induced resets; client SDK fix handles client cancels.

ryan: rolling revert to 100% because canary is clean. `deploy edge-proxy v2.4.2-revertkeepalive --canary=100% --region=us-west`

ops-bot: Full rollout succeeded.

maya: big improvement in global streaming 5xx rate. Current numbers: streaming 5xx rate baseline now back to normal within deployed region. Overall platform streaming 5xx down 82% since start.

james: PR for runtime heartbeat is open: https://git.internal/runtime/pull/532 (flag + tests). Target merge after post-incident review.

elaine: next steps: 1) postmortem draft, 2) permanent heartbeat enable, 3) add synthetic streaming checks with partial-chunk detection, 4) add a metric for mid-stream resets.

sachin: creating incident ticket INC-4928 with mitigation timeline and customer impact. Adding links to deploys and commands used.

customer-success: AcmeApps satisfied with immediate workaround, wants timeline for full fix (heartbeat). They prefer a communication template.

maya: I'll draft short customer note: explain root cause (edge idle timeout + disabled keepalive), mitigation (reverted config + fallback), ETA for heartbeat rollout (2 weeks).

incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated->monitoring. Severity decreased to SEV3. Oncall handoff to rota.

ryan: handing off to eng-runtime for follow-ups. sachin and james you own the postmortem and followups.

sachin: ack. Will update INC-4928 and schedule blameless postmortem.

maya: thanks all. I'll continue to monitor for 2h then close thread. :white_check_mark:
